g.aria-label: Title text 'What follows what, when the behaviour changes'

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: What follows what, when the behaviour changes

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A first-order Markov chain over one-second states, computed in SQL with LAG and row-normalised, pooled across all 45 dogs. Self-transitions are excluded — a behaviour is mostly followed by itself, and leaving that in hides everything else.'

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: A first-order Markov chain over one-second states, computed in SQL with LAG and row-normalised, pooled across all 45 dogs.
Self-transitions are excluded — a behaviour is mostly followed by itself, and leaving that in hides everything else.

not of its total time. Cells below 10% are left unlabelled.
